title: chore: daemon/proxy defect hunt: file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from packages/moe-daemon/src and packages/moe-proxy/src
description:
Filed by the governor on 2026-11-03, using the route architect-24611a0a proposed (msg-221a2552) and architect-1dd28c7c asked for (msg-498d6217). Notification-only architect sessions can't run a hunt, so it is a claimable row instead. Brief: msg-541a2cec.

WHY. Five coders are idle, and the PLANNING queue keeps running dry. The goal is 2-4 small, real, file-disjoint bug rows the idle coders can take.

LANE.
- Search packages/moe-daemon/src and packages/moe-proxy/src.
- Skip scripts/moe-agent.* and every file an open row's plan holds. Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start; the list moves.
- Held at filing time:
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/claudeAuth.ts, claudeAuth.test.ts and cli.ts (task-55710898);
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/state/accountStore.ts and accountStore.presence.test.ts (task-0c78c290);
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts, validators.test.ts, tools/claimNextTask.test.ts and types/schema.ts (WT-19, task-b1ca54f2).

EVIDENCE BAR. Work only from real evidence:
- a repro on HEAD 1558f141 or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout (global rail: never build or test in place);
- or a failure line from today's logs: file plus timestamp, e.g. .moe/activity.log or the daemon log.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan; do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code (status PLANNING, no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists). Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors with an @governor mention.
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task. The holder of a PLANNING row may archive it, so no second architect re-runs the hunt.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted, and the ids are posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 1558f141 or later (command and observed output, run outside the shared checkout), or a failure line from today's logs (file and timestamp).
No filed row targets scripts/moe-agent.* or a file held by an open row's plan, per lanes.js at hunt time; this row is archived by its holder once the ids are posted.
